issue.title: module loading error when used with webpack2 CommonsChunkPlugin
issue.body:
In some cases, it looks like using [CommonsChunkPlugin](https://webpack.js.org/plugins/commons-chunk-plugin/) with globalize-webpack-plugin can break module loading. This appears to happen when using a `CommonsChunkPlugin.maxChunks` value that is greater or equal to the number of supported locales. The same error does not happen when using webpack1. This may be related to #38, though after hacking up the regex described in #38 I've found the error is still reproducible.

I've put together a small test case at [jbellenger/globalize-webpack-plugin-testcase](https://github.com/jbellenger/globalize-webpack-plugin-testcase).

I'm open to putting together a PR, though I'm presently at a loss for why this is happening and could use some pointers on where to look.

body: @jbellenger Thank you so much for this report. :bow:

issue.title: fix hashing of RawModules
issue.body:
webpack-2 appears to have a [bug](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/issues/5070) where RawModules can produce hash collisions. Since globalize-webpack-plugin-1.0.0 introduced use of RawModules, this package is susceptible to emitting chunks with different contents but unchanged chunkhashes. This can cause cdns and browser caches to unwittingly use old assets and lead to irksome bugs.

Even though the root issue appears to be in webpack, this package should be patched to work around the issue in the versions of webpack that it supports.

Additionally, the required webpack version here is downgraded to match what is required by react-globalize-webpack-plugin.
